# artifacts

```go
import "github.com/rou-cru/takt-ai/takt/internal/artifacts"
```

Package artifacts holds helpers shared by the agent\-file renderers and the deployer: relative\-path normalization, ID validation, and deterministic sorted output.

## func EnsureTrailingNewline

```go
func EnsureTrailingNewline(content string) string
```

EnsureTrailingNewline appends a newline unless one is already present.

<a name="NormalizeRelPath"></a>
## func NormalizeRelPath

```go
func NormalizeRelPath(candidate string) (string, error)
```

NormalizeRelPath validates and cleans a slash\-separated relative path. It rejects empty paths, backslashes, parent\-directory components, and absolute paths.

<a name="SortUniqueByPath"></a>
## func SortUniqueByPath

```go
func SortUniqueByPath[T any](items []T, pathOf func(T) string, label string) ([]T, error)
```

SortUniqueByPath returns a copy of items sorted by their paths, or an error if multiple items have the same path. The label identifies the artifact type in the duplicate\-path error.

<a name="ValidateID"></a>
## func ValidateID

```go
func ValidateID(label, id string) error
```

ValidateID validates a sub\-agent ID and includes the owning target label in any error message.
